text:
hana: quick alert — discovered a partial replay from our S3 ingest connector that duplicated ~312k embed events for acct: LUMOS_LABS during 2026-03-28T11:10..11:40 UTC. looks like the connector retried a tail segment after a timeout. need pre-approval to apply a billing override and issue a credit memo.

matt: can you paste the counts?

hana: run:
```sql
-- window 2026-03-28 11:10..11:40 UTC
select count(*) from embeds_ingest where acct='LUMOS_LABS' and provider='s3-connector' and ts between '2026-03-28 11:10' and '2026-03-28 11:40'; -- 312,384
select count(*) from embeds_metered where acct='LUMOS_LABS' and ts between '2026-03-28 11:10' and '2026-03-28 11:40'; -- 42,384
-- delta likely duplicates = 270,000 (approx)
```

ops_izzy: ops notes: the connector retried an incomplete multipart manifest; parts 8..12 were replayed. we matched content_hash and found 269,912 exact matches to earlier event hashes. raw event log has 312k entries but 269,912 map to earlier IDs.

matt: good to know. how many were already invoiced?

hana: customer was invoiced yesterday morning; invoice INV-2026-0327 already issued using previous metering (did not include the replayed rows). so these replays would cause an overcount on today's metering export if left unhandled.

matt: pricing: embed SKU $0.0004 each. duplicates = 269,912 => credit amount = 269,912 * 0.0004 = $107.9648 -> rounds to $107.96.

billing.bot: Suggested action: create credit memo draft CM-2026-0328-LUMOS-107.96 with reason "s3-connector partial replay - nonbillable duplicates". Requires finance sign-off and quick legal ack.

legal_ny: contract check: vendor clause on third-party connectors indicates we may choose to credit where duplicate vendor activity caused double ingestion. okay to proceed, add memo language and keep audit CSV attached.

cfo_emma: two asks before approve: 1) confirm dedupe matching method (hash vs approximate), 2) confirm rollback path if we accidentally mark false positives.

hana: dedupe: exact content_hash (sha256) match + payload size + model signature. match confidence high. rollback: billing_overrides are reversible; we log audit events and can reverse override within 5 minutes if needed.

cfo_emma: approve $107.96 credit and backfill override. require memo note: "Credit for duplicate embeddings due to S3 connector partial replay on 2026-03-28". also CC legal in customer email.

billing.bot: Action queued: create credit memo draft CM-2026-0328-LUMOS-107.96. Reference thread 2146001234.

matt: hana, please upload audit CSV and kick off the backfill job. send link once uploaded.

hana: CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-recon/2146001234/lumos_dup_ids.csv (internal). starting override job now.

billing.bot: Credit memo draft created: CM-2026-0328-DRAFT-LUMOS-107.96. Awaiting finance finalize.

ops_izzy: backfill applied: overrides written for 269,912 event_ids. ledger delta staged. monitored metrics show no unexpected regressions.

billing.bot: Credit memo finalized and posted: CM-2026-0328-LUMOS-107.96. Status: posted. Invoice note added: "Credit: duplicates from S3 connector partial replay; internal ref 2146001234."

matt: please confirm notification to customer and attach audit CSV.

hana: customer email queued (cc legal_ny): "We identified duplicate embedding events from a partial connector replay on 2026-03-28. A credit of $107.96 has been issued (CM-2026-0328). Attached is an itemized audit CSV. Reply to dispute within 7 days."

cfo_emma: thanks. please add a short postmortem task to infra to add an S3 multipart manifest checksum check to prevent replays and an exporter alert when manifest tail retries occur.

hana: creating INFRA ticket and runbook PR. closing thread unless customer disputes.
